task: Reuse the ARM HAL mini-UART byte writer in the RPi3 TrapFrame diagnostic.
acceptanceCriteria: The task diagnostic contains no private mini-UART polling or write implementation.
Every diagnostic byte is emitted through uart_bcm_mini::probe_put.
Cfg gating, formatting, labels, volatile read, and task setup order remain unchanged.
blastRadius: RPi3 TrapFrame debug output during task setup
scoutSummary: The debug block duplicated the FIFO-safe byte writer already provided by ARM HAL.
